weakness: The prior freshness rule treated the receipt-bearing branch head and the tested evidence subject as the same commit, creating a self-reference problem whenever governance metadata changed after a hosted run.
hypothesis: Separating evidence_subject_sha from receipt_commit_sha will preserve truthful evidence binding while allowing governance-only repairs without falsely describing untested commits as tested.
rules: evidence_subject_sha identifies the exact commit whose workflow and job conclusions were observed
receipt_commit_sha identifies the commit that stores the receipt and may differ from evidence_subject_sha
a task cannot be accepted unless the latest reviewed implementation head is itself the evidence_subject_sha of a passing required workflow
governance-only commits may preserve blocked status while referencing the most recent tested implementation head
rollback: Remove this experiment and restore the prior single-SHA freshness rule; retain receipts and queue history as evidence of the ambiguity.
